level.title: Arabic C1+ — Almost native
goals: Architect a work report and cut institutional Arabic down to what it needs
Translate with a chosen register, catch calques and check by back-translation
Teach a beginner a rule, correct kindly, and work from the root rather than by rote

lessons.title: Report architecture: ملخّص، نتائج، توصيات
lessons.learn: A formal Arabic report has four rooms: ملخّص تنفيذي (executive summary), نتائج (findings), توصيات (recommendations), ملحق (annex). Each has its own verb mood — findings report, recommendations propose, and neither argues.

grammar.title: Four rooms, three moods
grammar.pattern: findings: tadullu / tushīr · recommendations: nawṣī bi- / yuqtaraḥ · summary: khulāṣa
grammar.explain: النتائج: تدلّ الأرقام على تحسّن محدود. التوصيات: نوصي بتمديد المهلة شهراً. Neither section should contain the other's sentences — that is the most common structural fault in Arabic reports.

examples.t: يستعرض الملخّص التنفيذي أهمّ ثلاث نتائج.
examples.r: yastaʿriḍ al-mulakhkhaṣ al-tanfīdhī ahamm thalāth natāʾij.
examples.en: The executive summary presents the three key findings.

examples.t: نوصي بتوسيع العيّنة في المرحلة الثانية.
examples.r: nawṣī bi-tawṣīʿ al-ʿayyina fī al-marḥala al-thāniya.
examples.en: We recommend widening the sample in the second phase.

examples.t: تجدون التفاصيل في الملحق الثاني.
examples.r: tajidūn al-tafāṣīl fī al-mulḥaq al-thānī.
examples.en: You will find the details in annex two.

mistakes.why: A recommendation recorded under findings blurs the document's authority.

mistakes.wrong: نوصي بتمديد المهلة شهراً، لذلك يجب…
mistakes.why: The recommendation section proposes; the argument belongs to the summary.

dialogue.t: أريد المسودّة الليلة: ملخّص ونتائج وتوصيات.
dialogue.r: urīd al-musawwada al-layla: mulakhkhaṣ wa-natāʾij wa-tawṣiyāt.
dialogue.en: I want the draft tonight: summary, findings, recommendations.

dialogue.t: هل أضع التوصيات في الملخّص التنفيذي؟
dialogue.r: hal aḍaʿ al-tawṣiyāt fī al-mulakhkhaṣ al-tanfīdhī?
dialogue.en: Do I put the recommendations in the executive summary?
A signpost only — the rest in its own section.
And the technical details?
In the annex; don't weigh down the summary.

lessons.title: Trimming institutional prose
lessons.learn: Institutional Arabic pads itself with قام بـ (carried out the doing of), تجدر الإشارة (it deserves noting), في إطار (within the framework of). A C1+ writer cuts them: the verb comes back, and the document gets shorter and stronger.

grammar.title: Cut the frame, keep the verb
grammar.pattern: qāma bi- + verbal noun → the verb itself · fī iṭār + verbal noun → the noun
grammar.explain: قامت الوزارة بتنفيذ الخطة → نفّذت الوزارة الخطة. في إطار تحسين الخدمات، أطلقنا → حسّنّا الخدمات وأطلقنا. Each cut returns a verb to the sentence.

examples.t: نفّذت الوزارة الخطة قبل موعدها.
examples.r: naffadhat al-wizāra al-khuṭṭa qabla mawʿidihā.
examples.en: The ministry implemented the plan ahead of time.

examples.t: حسّنّا الخدمات وأطلقنا منصة جديدة.
examples.r: ḥassannā al-khadamāt wa-aṭlaqnā mannaṣṣa jadīda.
examples.en: We improved the services and launched a new platform.

examples.t: يبدأ التنفيذ في مارس.
examples.r: yabdā al-tanfīdh fī Mārs.
examples.en: Implementation begins in March.

mistakes.why: قام بـ adds a verb and removes one; the sentence loses a syllable and gains a subject.

mistakes.wrong: تجدر الإشارة إلى أنّ الزراعة تحسّنت.
mistakes.why: If the sentence is worth writing, it is worth asserting.

dialogue.en: Cut the padding: from 'carried out' straight to the verb.

lessons.title: Editing protocol: suggest, don't rewrite
lessons.learn: Editing someone's Arabic in a team has a protocol: هذا اقتراح تعديل (this is a suggested edit), هل يمكن أن نعيد الصياغة؟ (may we rephrase?), التعليق في الهامش (comment in the margin), and mark whose text it is. The writer stays the owner; the editor stays honest.

grammar.title: Suggest, explain, release
grammar.pattern: hādhā iqtirāḥ taʿdīl · hal yumkin an nuʿīd al-ṣiyāgha? · al-taʿlīq fī al-hāmish
grammar.explain: اقتراح: الفعل «أفاد» أوضح من «قال» هنا. التعليل: لأنّ النصّ خبر رسمي. Then leave it to the writer — an edit without an explanation is a demand.

examples.t: هذا اقتراح تعديل، والتعديل النهائي لك.
examples.r: hādhā iqtirāḥ taʿdīl, wa-l-taʿdīl al-nihāʾī lak.
examples.en: This is a suggested edit; the final call is yours.

examples.t: هل يمكن أن نعيد صياغة الجملة الأولى؟
examples.r: hal yumkin an nuʿīd ṣiyāghat al-jumla al-ūlā?
examples.en: May we rephrase the first sentence?

examples.t: تركتُ تعليقاً في الهامش مع السبب.
examples.r: taraktu taʿlīqan fī al-hāmish maʿa al-sabab.
examples.en: I left a comment in the margin with the reason.

mistakes.why: Rewriting the writer's text takes ownership that is not the editor's.

mistakes.right: هل يمكن أن نعيد الصياغة؟ السبب أنّ…
mistakes.why: In a professional edit, name the reason and let the writer decide.

dialogue.t: أعدتُ صياغة الفقرة الثالثة، هل تسمح؟

dialogue.r: ufaḍḍil an yakūn iqtirāḥan, lā taʿdīlan mubāshiran.
dialogue.en: I prefer a suggestion rather than a direct edit.

lessons.title: Choosing a register before you translate
lessons.learn: Before the first word, decide the register: فصحى معاصرة (contemporary written), فصحى تراثية (classical, for legal and religious registers), or عامية for a subtitle. The same sentence has three correct translations and only one right one per job.

grammar.title: Register first, then words
grammar.explain: «Please find attached» → للمخاطب الرسمي: نرفق لكم؛ لرسالة ودّية: أرسل لك المرفق. The audience and the purpose pick the register; the dictionary does not.

examples.t: للمخاطب الرسمي: نرفق لكم نسخة من الاتفاق.
examples.r: li-l-mukhāṭab al-rasmī: nurfiq lakum nuskha min al-ittifāq.
examples.en: For the formal addressee: we attach a copy of the agreement.

examples.t: لرسالة ودّية: أرسل لك الملف، راجعه وقت ما تحبّ.
examples.r: li-risāla wuddiyya: ursil lak al-milaff, rājiʿhu waqt mā tuḥibb.
examples.en: For a friendly message: here's the file, review it whenever you like.

examples.t: للترجمة القانونية: يُرفق طيّه نسخة موقّعة.
examples.r: li-l-tarjama al-qānūniyya: yurfaq ṭayyah nuskha muwaqqaʿa.
examples.en: For a legal translation: a signed copy is attached hereto.

mistakes.wrong: مترجم واحد لكل السياقات بأسلوب واحد.
mistakes.why: One style for every job is the mark of a machine translation, not a translator.
Literal fidelity is a decision, not a default.

lessons.title: Calques and false friends
lessons.learn: Translation traps hide in ordinary words: 'actually' is في الواقع, not فعلياً (which means literally); 'eventually' is في النهاية, not أحياناً; 'to assume' is يفترض, not يتّهم (accuse). A calque is grammatically correct and still not Arabic.

grammar.title: False friends to check
grammar.pattern: actually → fī al-wāqiʿ · eventually → fī al-nihāya · assume → yaftariḍ · concrete (adj) → māddī
grammar.explain: هو في الواقع محقّ (he is actually right). في النهاية وصلنا (eventually we arrived). الخرسانة is concrete the material; ملموس is concrete as an adjective.

examples.r: fī al-wāqiʿ, lam yaṣil al-taqrīr baʿd.
examples.en: Actually, the report has not arrived yet.

examples.t: في النهاية، اتّفقنا على سعر أقلّ.
examples.r: fī al-nihāya, ittafaqnā ʿalā siʿr aqall.
examples.en: Eventually we agreed on a lower price.

examples.t: لنفترض أنّ الأرقام صحيحة.
examples.r: li-naftariḍ anna al-arqām ṣaḥīḥa.
examples.en: Let us assume the figures are correct.

mistakes.why: فعلياً means 'in practice, de facto'; 'actually' is في الواقع.
'Eventually' is not أحياناً (sometimes); it is في النهاية.

lessons.title: Back-translation as a check
lessons.learn: The professional habit: translate your Arabic back into English and see what survived. If the back-translation drifts — certainty grew, politeness vanished, an actor appeared from nowhere — the first translation is wrong, not the second.

grammar.title: Back-translate and compare
grammar.pattern: translate → back-translate → compare certainty, politeness, actor
grammar.explain: نرجو التكرم بالاطلاع → 'we request you kindly review' → back: 'we request you kindly review' ✓. If 'perhaps' comes back as 'certainly', the drift is in the first direction.

examples.en: I back-translated to check the degree of certainty.

examples.en: The meaning did not change, but the tone did.

lessons.title: Explain a rule: القاعدة، مثال، ملاحظة
lessons.learn: A rule explained in three moves sticks: القاعدة (the rule), مثال (an example), ملاحظة (the exception or warning). Arabic teaching texts, from the old grammars to a modern textbook, run on exactly this order.

grammar.title: Rule → example → note
grammar.explain: القاعدة: الفعل بعد لم يكون مجزوماً. مثال: لم يذهبْ. ملاحظة: لا تظهر السكون في الكتابة، لكنّها تُسمع في القراءة. Three lines, and the learner can use it before understanding it fully.

examples.t: القاعدة: أنّ تفتح الجملة بعد أفعال القول.
examples.r: al-qāʿida: أنّ tafthaḥ al-jumla baʿda afʿāl al-qawl.
examples.en: The rule: أنّ opens the clause after verbs of speech.

examples.t: مثال: قال إنّ الاجتماع تأجّل.
examples.r: mithāl: qāla inna al-ijtimāʿ taʾajjal.
examples.en: Example: he said that the meeting was postponed.

examples.t: ملاحظة: بعد «قال» تُستخدم إنّ، وبعد «أفاد» تُستخدم بأنّ.
examples.r: mulāḥaẓa: baʿda «qāla» tustakhdam inn, wa-baʿda «afāda» tustakhdam bi-ann.
examples.en: Note: after قال use إنّ; after أفاد use بأنّ.

mistakes.right: القاعدة: الفعل بعد لم يكون مجزوماً.
mistakes.why: A rule must state a pattern, not an opinion about the pattern.

mistakes.wrong: مثال: قال إنّ، ملاحظة: إنّ، وهكذا.
mistakes.why: Listing markers is not teaching; the example has to be a sentence.

dialogue.en: What is the difference between إنّ and أنّ?

dialogue.t: القاعدة: إنّ تفتح جملة مستقلّة، وأنّ تعمل داخل الجملة.
dialogue.r: al-qāʿida: inn tafthaḥ jumla mustaqilla, wa-ann taʿmal dākhil al-jumla.
dialogue.en: The rule: إنّ opens an independent sentence; أنّ works inside it.
An example?

dialogue.t: إنّ الجوّ جميل. أعلم أنّ الجوّ جميل.

lessons.title: Roots and patterns instead of rote
lessons.learn: Arabic rewards the learner who sees the root. ك-ت-ب gives كتب، كاتب، مكتوب، كتاب، مكتبة. Teach the root once and the vocabulary multiplies — and warn about the trap: Latin transliteration cannot carry what the script already does.

culture.text: Arabic writing for work is a craft with its own etiquette: formulas open and close the text, the passive and the verbal noun carry institutional distance, and a translator is expected to choose a register before choosing words. The oldest continuous translation tradition in the region — Baghdad's House of Wisdom — is remembered for exactly the habit this level teaches: render the meaning, then argue about the wording.

reading.text: تجدر الإشارة إلى أنّ نصّ البيان يحتاج ضبطاً في درجة اليقين: «تؤكّد الوزارة» غير «تشير مصادر». وقد لاحظ المراجع أنّ الفعل «قال» تكرّر خمس مرّات، والأفضل تنويعه: أفاد، صرّح، نقل عن. أمّا العنوان فيسمح بحرية أكبر، بشرط ألّا يوحي بما لا يقوله النصّ.
reading.gloss: It is worth noting that the text of the statement needs its degree of certainty fixed: 'the ministry confirms' is not 'sources indicate'. The reviewer observed that the verb 'said' was repeated five times, and it is better to vary it: reported, declared, quoted. The headline, however, allows more freedom — provided it does not suggest what the text does not say.
